meta.question: Checking whether a 'next bullet' item gives its bonus to one pellet or to every pellet of a multi-pellet shot, and what Express Shot does to a shotgun-style shot.
meta.purpose: decides if next-bullet items (Mystic Shot, Headshot Booster, Headhunter, Restorative Shot, Express Shot) are worth buying on multi-pellet or burst weapons: 7 builds hold one on such a hero
meta.mechanics: the data caps these items at one bullet per shot (m_flMaxBulletsToProcInShot=1, no multiple procs per shot or per target; VERIFIED MECHANIC). Drifter's weapon fires m_iBullets=3 per shot (cycle 0.441 s), Haze 1 per shot (cycle 0.105 s). Whether the cap means 1 pellet of 3, and what Express Shot does (fires twice, uses extra ammo) is UNRESOLVED
meta.feeds: novel hypothesis N04 (next-bullet items on pellet/burst weapons)
meta.prediction_haze_control: Haze: exactly one extra spirit row on the first bullet of M, nothing further inside 8 s (item cooldown); E: first shot comes out twice with more damage and a larger ammo drop
meta.prediction_drifter_CAP: Drifter M: one extra spirit row in total (cap of 1 respected) attached to one of the three first-shot pellets
meta.prediction_drifter_ALL: Drifter M: three extra rows on the first shot (cap counts shots, not pellets)
meta.prediction_drifter_ME: ME: the bonus rides on the first bullet of the first volley only (Express Shot extra volley carries none) if the cap is per shot
meta.decision_rule: CAP: a next-bullet bonus is worth one pellet of three; the model divides its value by the pellet count on Drifter, Yamato (5), Calico (9), Shiv (6) style weapons and the builds in changes_builds drop or downgrade the item where the share is under about a third. ALL: item value counts every pellet, no change. Express Shot rows without ammo readback: report volleys and damage only
meta.changes_builds: yamato, yamato_brawler, paradox, lash, pocket, abrams_melee, shiv_gun
meta.unresolved_if: Drifter blocks show no pellet rows (gun not firing: statecheck first); per-row timestamps cannot separate shots (report row counts per 0.5 s instead)
meta.selection_reason: independent theorycraft: item text says next bullet, data caps it at 1 bullet per shot, and many heroes fire several bullets per shot
meta.alternative_reason: Haze (1 bullet per shot) is the control hero in the same file
meta.rotation: two heroes in sequence (the setup line switches); blocks X0, M, E, ME then reversed; 1.3 s of fire per block
meta.blocked_by: ammo count after the shot is not a runner readback (only GunFired/BulletHit counts via acclog); Drifter gun operation not yet exercised in a queue run: run a statecheck block first
meta.result_says: WORKS if the bonus lands on every pellet of the first shot; DOES NOT WORK (cap) if exactly one pellet carries it
